title: Mary Pat's Tuna Melt
description: Crispy potato chips add a crunchy crust to these zesty tuna melts with pickles and red onion, perfect for a creamy, cheesy dinner for two.
ingredients: 1 (5 ounce) can olive-oil packed tuna, undrained
1 cup coarsely crushed potato chips (such as Utz®)

steps.text: Mix tuna, 1/4 cup mayonnaise, and Dijon mustard together in a small bowl. Stir in pickle and red onion. Spread tuna mixture on 2 slices of bread. Top each with 2 slices of Cheddar cheese.
Spread 1 tablespoon cream cheese on each of the remaining 2 slices of bread. Place on top of the Cheddar cheese.
Place crushed chips in a shallow bowl. Spread top side of each tuna melt with 1 1/2 teaspoon mayonnaise and press into the chips. Repeat on other side.
Heat a dry grill pan over medium-high heat. Toast tuna melts until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side.

video.description: Satisfy all your senses with a crispy take on the diner favorite. Tuna salad studded with dill pickle, red onion and a touch of Dijon mustard is paired with cream cheese and Irish cheddar for ultimate meltiness. But wait, there’s more! Once assembled, this awesome sandwich is coated with mayo and crushed potato chips then grilled to perfection. What are you waiting for? Only a few minutes separate you from this seriously delicious sandwich.
